groups.definition: Reliance on limited, single-source or subcontracted suppliers (such as foundries and parts makers) whose shortages or disruptions could prevent the company from meeting demand.

groups.canonical_name: Semiconductor product defect and liability claims
groups.definition: Defects in the company's semiconductor products could lead to liability claims, customer recall cost recovery demands, replacement costs and injury exposure that insurance may not fully cover.
Recalls of the company's vehicles, amplified by global platforms and autonomous vehicle safety concerns, could create large costs and reputational damage.

groups.canonical_name: Limited recall cost recovery from suppliers
groups.definition: The company may be unable to recover recall costs from suppliers for defective components because of the suppliers' financial condition or because defects surface years after production.
